import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    
    # Print array before modification
    print("Array before modification:")
    print(" ".join(map(str, arr)), end=" \n")
    
    # Modify each element by adding 4
    for i in range(n):
        arr[i] += 4
    
    # Print array after modification
    print("Array after modification:")
    print(" ".join(map(str, arr)), end=" \n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
